name: Open Vision Banana
paper_title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
license_interpretation: The Open Vision Banana weights are fine-tunes of FLUX.2 [klein] Base 4B and 9B and are under Black Forest Labs' FLUX Non-Commercial License, a custom agreement that is not OSI-approved: no commercial or production use. Section 2(e) of that license asks for content filtering or human review of generated images before they are shared, and the same terms apply to the outputs. FunAILab's training code on GitHub is Apache-2.0, but LibreYOLO ports none of it: its adapter is its own MIT code that calls the Apache-2.0 diffusers Flux2KleinPipeline. LibreYOLO redistributes the paper's non-zero-shot checkpoints as complete pipelines at LibreYOLO/LibreOpenVisionBanana4b and LibreYOLO/LibreOpenVisionBanana9b, with FunAILab's transformer cast from float32 to bfloat16 (from FunAILab/Open-Vision-Banana at revision be5da66250cc385ff9c75ebbe4114e13ec305848) and Black Forest Labs' scheduler, Qwen3 text encoder, tokenizer and VAE byte-identical; the mirrors carry the license and are not gated. The zero-shot checkpoints and LoRA adapters stay on FunAILab's repository, under the same license.
